ratings_why.fun: Every turn asks how much to owe, when to pay and in what size, and the count, lump and Ledger payoffs pull on the same number. A few cards are plain bookkeeping, though.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7: Debt is a combat stat that Skims spend mid-fight while Black Feather and Hooded Crow Heavy want it high. No tribe today turns your own gold debt into a fight resource, with Mr Magpie's slot setting when the bill lands.

verdict_why: The engine is settled, but Mr Magpie at zero Debt and the twice-a-turn caps during fights need clear rules first.

points.text: Mr Magpie with no Debt: is that 'not repaid', so 1 free gold a turn? If so, every back row wants him with no Debt at all. Say he needs Debt to pay out.
Skims repay during the fight. Does 'Twice a turn' on Corbie's Grandchick count the fight as part of the turn? Say whether fight repayments use up the two.
Skims count as repayments, so Thought and Memory doubles Sorrow and Joy on a Skim but not Seven, which says 'Skims'. Say which triggers count as 'when you repay Debt'.
Tower Raven's Start of Combat Borrow followed by The Black Feather in reading order is a lovely slot puzzle. Show it in the hand-play preview so players find it.
Uncle Jack plus Mr Magpie lets you hold Debt just under 10 for good, selling a unit each turn to stay there. That's a great Johnny line; let the bill preview show the hover.

standouts.why: Board position decides when the bill comes due, and moving him to the front row a turn early is a real choice.
Turns every sale, any tribe's Created units included, into a repayment event, so golden hunting and Fly South feed the engine.
Wants Debt high, while its own Skim lowers it. A whole tension on one card.

weakest.why: One obvious job: borrow 2 on the turn it completes a buy.
A Borrow every turn with no twist. It reads as a trap on its own.
Reads a total that only rises, so it asks for no decisions.

flags.note: Free gold at zero Debt is unclear, and so is whether all Debt repays once it passes 10.
With Tower Raven and The Belfry Mob, Borrow then Skim it all back can net about 5 free gold a fight.
Mr Magpie plus Uncle Jack can keep Debt near 10 every fight, so +10/+10 to the tribe each fight.
Unclear whether repayments in a fight count toward 'Twice a turn'.
